title: Canned lines are optional; Settings edits flow through
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test.
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. A service with no canned lines, and another service with a canned line you will edit/delete in Settings.
custom_steps:
1. Save a service with no canned lines and confirm it works.
  2. Edit a canned line in Settings and check what the service adds afterwards.
  3. Delete a canned line in Settings and re-open the service.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A service with no canned lines saves normally and is fully functional; a shop that types every line freeform is never prompted to use this.
  • A canned line edited later in Settings changes what the service adds from then on.
  • A canned line deleted in Settings leaves the service with one fewer line, without error.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10561 (S4, Attach canned lines to a service), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S4 (unchanged requirements); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
